title: Sample Mini Reviewer
subtitle: Tiny 3-question pack to test the reusable Quizzer library

questions.question: What does a reusable Quizzer load?
choices: Any matching JSON, TXT, or MD quiz in the library format
Only the first hardcoded quiz forever

explanations.0: Quizzer accepts the same question shape used by this reviewer, from .json, .txt, or .md files.
explanations.1: PDFs are not a supported quiz format here.
explanations.2: The built-in quiz is one pack; you can open others from the library.
explanations.3: Quizzes come from local storage and imported files, not arbitrary websites.

questions.question: A file has questions but no choices array. What should Quizzer do?
choices: Hide it because the format does not match

explanations.0: Missing choices means it is not a valid reviewer question.
explanations.1: Only files with question, choices, and a correct index are listed.
explanations.2: Quizzer does not convert files to PDF.
explanations.3: Install is unrelated to format validation.

questions.question: You finished one reviewer and want a different subject. What do you do?
choices: Edit the HTML by hand each time
Go back to the picker and open another quiz

explanations.0: You do not need to reset the browser.
explanations.1: The library is meant to be reused without rewriting the app.
explanations.2: Use Quizzes / Other Quiz to return to the picker and switch packs.
explanations.3: Removing storage would delete imported quizzes.
